# Local Demo Mode Explained

## What this page does

This article explains the local demo mode messages and safety limits shown in the tester package.

## When to use it

Use it when you want to understand what the demo can and cannot do.

## Before you begin

Start the app with `START-ClearPathPayroll.bat`.

## Step-by-step instructions

1. Open the app home page.
2. Look for the local demo mode banner.
3. Confirm the banner says data is local and real ACH/tax filing is not enabled.
4. Open `/prototype-test-checklist`.
5. Mark the local demo mode checks complete.

## What to check

- Local/demo wording is visible.
- No real ACH or tax filing action is offered.
- The app uses fake/sandbox workflows for testing.

## Common messages or errors

- If no banner appears, note the page and include a screenshot.
- If a page asks for live credentials, stop and report it.

## What this page does not do

Local demo mode does not make the app a production payroll system.

## Privacy/safety notes

Use demo data only. ClearPath Payroll does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, payroll compliance, or licensed professional advice.
